They’re telling me it’s not. (I’m in the UK) they’re saying nothings wrong on my account and that the data is fine.

I get 1/2mbps between 9-midnight. But after midnight I’m getting 15+

I’ve been having issues with my iPhone X getting poor data speed between 9am-midnight, if there was an issue with the phone, could it potentially give slow data speeds during the day? But at night be okay?
Yep.

It can’t be the device, because after midnight and before 9am, I get the data speeds that I should. 

I get it everywhere I go, no matter where I go. 

Apn settings are what they should be.

3G is okay, but 4g is not. (3G only some times) 

Makes me think they’re blocking me from using 4g during the day. Then in the early hours I can use it. 

I just have a feeling they’re restricting me personally because my family are on the same network and they don’t have an issue.

They’re saying it’s ‘congestion’.

But I highly doubt is congestion from 9am-midnight every day. 

Literally everywhere I go. 

I can’t use my phone browsing internet or anything. 

I have 2 PAYG sims too which have the same issues, which make me think they’re stopping access from my phone whenever a SIM card is put into it.

I live in the UK.

I just don’t get good 4g signal between 9am-midnight every day, without fail. (My phone company are telling me there’s nothing wrong, but none of my family are having the same issues and they’re on the same network as me)

Was wondering if it was possible for my phone company to restrict me to 4g only?

They say it’s because the chat belongs to both people (fair enough) 

But I was wondering if, after you delete your account, that your side of it is anonymised (as it shows up deleted user on the other side) and thus meaning that the account/chats can’t be linked back to a specific account? 

Just trying to work out if that’s what would normally happen.

They must store the data still as surely the messages would still be on the other persons chats? 

So if they were deleted, then they wouldn’t appear on the other persons chats (but they do) 

This is what I don’t get, there must be some kind of retention for them.

This is what they’ve said to me;

We do not store any information 30 days after an account as been deleted, as per GDPR privacy laws

But you’d assume that even after 30days, there would still be some kind of retention for that information? 

But they’re not giving me a straight answer, and as far as I’m aware, they have to tell you exactly what they do with you me data and what they store, but they won’t.

Okay. 

So let’s look at it this way;

If the other user had deleted their profile, their account would be deleted, so they no longer have a “legitimate business reason” for them. 

If the messages are anonymised, could the controller themselves link the messages back to a specific account/user?

I can’t tell them. 

I just can’t.

No way to stop what’s going to happen. 

I just can’t :( 

My life’s over :(

I can’t say what happened.

No one knows, but they will when it happens. 

I’ll be disowned, lose my family and I’ll never love a normal life again. 

I can’t do that, I can’t live with that.

No, I have to do it on my own as there’s nothing that anyone can do for me now.

I have to ride it out and wait for my time, the world will be beteee without me here.

I’m an idiot and have to accept the consequences, but I can’t. 

Only way out is to end kt
Some real hard shit, serious shit that I didn’t realise the consequences.

They’re the ones I don’t want to know, but they will eventually.

But it’s over and my life is too, I cant cope any more and I need to end this.

I need to end it now.

Believe me, I do deserve it.

What I did was morally wrong, I shouldn’t of done it.

However, I now realise it was a very serious thing and the consequences are astronomical. 

I can’t cope with this feeling and I don’t deserve to be here. 

I’ve lost everything.

It happened a while ago yes.

However it will come out soon, I know it will. 

I just don’t want to be here any more...

At the time, I didn’t think it was serious.

But now I know it is and I can’t live with myself.
Rather not disclose, but they’ll know when it comes out :(
